prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic night photograph, straight-on to a plain dark brick wall on a quiet UK side street, shot on a 50mm lens at f/1.8 from across the road. The wall fills most of the frame and sits in near-black shadow, with a broad, smooth, empty area at the centre where the bricks are barely visible. Along the bottom edge, a soft out-of-focus strip of wet pavement catches warm amber and red reflections. Along the top edge, a few large soft bokeh circles of amber and cyan street lamps hang in the dark. A faint warm wash spills across the far right bricks, as if headlights are about to swing round the corner. Moody, deep blacks, subtle film grain. Thanks.
